title: humboltia caulescens
intro: Humboltia caulescens, commonly known as Indian spurge, is a medicinal plant that belongs to the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, and it has been used to treat various health issues such as skin infections, wounds, and digestive problems.
